name: "Candy Corn" Parfaits with Pineapple, Orange & Whipped Cream

instructions.primary_message: Place a medium bowl (preferably metal) in the freezer to chill. (If space is limited, place in the refrigerator.)
Wash, dry, and cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Divide pineapple between glasses or jars. (Stemless wine glasses work great for this.)

Wash and dry the oranges. Cut off skin and white pith from each orange, slice between the membranes to release segments, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the glasses with the pineapple and set aside.
Remove bowl from the freezer. Pour cold cream, sugar, and vanilla into the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 fl oz heavy whipping cream
2 tsp granulated sugar
½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Use a whisk (or hand blender) to beat the cream vigorously, until medium-soft peaks form, about 3 minutes if whisking. (When you pull the whisk out of the bowl, the cream should hold its shape, with a peak that curls over slightly.)
To serve, top fruit parfaits with whipped cream and sprinkle with candy corn. Enjoy!
